problem: Public English localization failed because the configured Anthropic account had insufficient API credits, while the terminal Netlify fallback also failed because a short-lived MCP proxy URL had been stored as a persistent GitHub Actions secret.
root_cause: Anthropic returned HTTP 400 invalid_request_error: credit balance too low. The same account-wide failure affected both Haiku translation and Sonnet website QA.
NETLIFY_MCP_PROXY_PATH_TEMP is a short-lived JWE/proxy credential. Persisting it in GitHub Actions outlived its validity window and caused HTTP 401 during terminal deployment.
The localized build retried non-transient provider errors and therefore discovered an unrecoverable credit condition late instead of failing immediately with a classified cause.
failed_approaches: Treating provider pacing/rate limiting as the primary i18n cause before testing a one-string provider call.
Storing a temporary Netlify MCP proxy URL as if it were a durable CI deployment credential.
Using a raw GitHub zipball as Netlify source without stripping its top-level archive directory, which temporarily published a nested site tree without redirects/functions.
Testing production provider health through the broken nested deploy before first restoring the full site stack.
prevention: Classify provider HTTP errors and fail immediately on non-transient credit/auth failures; retry only transient 429/5xx classes.
Production localization must surface STATIC_I18N_PROVIDER_CREDIT_EXHAUSTED distinctly from rate limiting or malformed translation output.
Production deployment prefers a durable NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN. A short-lived MCP proxy may only be a per-run fallback and must never be treated as a permanent credential.
A production source ZIP must have repository files at archive root and carry .bg-source-commit before Netlify upload.
Before terminal deployment, verify provider readiness and deploy credential class; do not spend a full build discovering a known hard boundary.
Never claim English LIVE_BEWEZEN while provider credits are exhausted or while the production browser proof has not passed.
